symptom_terms.en: loss of bladder or bowel control

text.zh-CN:
马尾综合征是腰骶部多条神经根功能受损，常与受压有关。

- 它可影响双腿、会阴感觉及膀胱肠道功能，不只是普通腰痛。
- 马尾是脊髓下端向下延伸的一束神经根，负责双腿和盆腔器官的信息传递。受损后可同时影响感觉、力量和排泄控制，因此疼痛并不能代表全部严重程度。
text.en:
Cauda equina syndrome affects several lower spinal nerve roots, commonly through compression.

- It can affect the legs, saddle sensation and bladder or bowel function, beyond ordinary back pain.
- The cauda equina is a bundle of nerve roots continuing below the spinal cord, carrying messages for the legs and pelvic organs. Damage can affect sensation, strength and bladder or bowel control, so pain alone does not show its full severity.

text.zh-CN:
病因决定解除压迫的具体方法。

- 较大的椎间盘突出、椎管狭窄、肿瘤、感染或外伤都可能相关。
- 椎间盘组织突出可占据神经原有的空间；椎管狭窄使可用空间进一步变小。肿块、感染或骨折也可能压迫神经，因此医生需要确定病因，而不是把所有病例当成同一种腰椎间盘病。
text.en:
The cause determines how compression is relieved.

- A large disc herniation, spinal stenosis, tumour, infection or trauma may be responsible.
- A herniated disc can occupy space normally available to the nerves; spinal stenosis narrows that space further. A mass, infection or fracture can also compress nerves, so clinicians establish the cause rather than treat every case as the same disc problem.

text.zh-CN:
腰腿症状伴新出现的排尿困难、大小便失控或会阴麻木，应立即急诊评估。

- 不要等到完全尿不出或双腿瘫痪；生殖器感觉改变、性功能变化和进行性腿无力也应主动说明。
- 尿潴留不一定只是完全尿不出，也可能表现为感觉不到膀胱已满；膀胱过满后反而可能漏尿。会阴或鞍区包括肛门、生殖器和臀部周围，擦拭时感觉改变也要说明。
text.en:
Back or leg symptoms with new urinary difficulty, loss of bladder or bowel control, or saddle numbness need immediate emergency assessment.

- Do not wait for complete retention or paralysis; report genital sensory or sexual changes and progressive leg weakness.
- Urinary retention may involve loss of the normal sensation of a full bladder, and an overfull bladder may leak. The saddle region includes the anus, genitals and buttocks; mention changed sensation when wiping as well.

text.zh-CN:
怀疑马尾受压时走急诊脊柱评估路径。

- 告诉团队症状何时开始、排尿和会阴感觉怎样改变，不因羞于描述而遗漏。
- 如已被告知没有急性压迫，但回家后出现新的排尿排便异常、会阴感觉改变或腿脚无力，应重新紧急求医。先前的检查不能排除以后出现新问题。
text.en:
Suspected cauda equina compression requires emergency spinal assessment.

- Tell the team when symptoms began and how urination and saddle sensation changed; do not omit intimate symptoms out of embarrassment.
- If acute compression was not found but new bladder or bowel changes, saddle sensory changes or leg/foot weakness develop after discharge, seek urgent reassessment. Earlier assessment cannot exclude a new problem later.

text.zh-CN:
诊断要把神经检查与影像结合。

- MRI可显示神经根和压迫原因；医生也可能评估膀胱残余尿及其他检查，不能只凭疼痛程度判断。
- 神经检查会了解腿部力量、感觉和反射，并询问发病经过及膀胱肠道变化。MRI 观察神经周围空间及压迫部位；影像必须与症状一起解释。
- 膀胱超声可测量排尿前后尿量，帮助判断是否排空。残余尿异常有多种原因，不能单凭这一项检查就确诊马尾综合征。
- 如果 MRI 未显示需要手术的压迫，症状仍然值得处理。团队会根据检查结果安排其他病因评估和疼痛管理；没有手术指征不等于症状不存在。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines neurological examination with imaging.

- MRI shows nerve roots and potential compression; assessment may include residual bladder urine and other tests, rather than pain severity alone.
- Assessment reviews leg strength, sensation and reflexes alongside symptom onset and bladder or bowel changes. MRI shows the space around the nerves and sites of compression; imaging is interpreted with symptoms.
- Bladder ultrasound can measure urine before and after voiding to assess emptying. An abnormal residual volume has several possible causes and does not by itself diagnose CES.
- If MRI does not show compression requiring surgery, symptoms still merit care. Findings guide investigation of other causes and pain management; no surgical indication does not mean no symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
腰腿痛很常见，但有危险信号时需要排除马尾综合征。

- 症状与其他神经问题可相似；检查是为了确定病变部位和是否有压迫。
- 普通腰腿痛、局部神经根受压和马尾综合征可有重叠症状。新出现的膀胱肠道、鞍区感觉或进行性力量变化，使评估重点从缓解疼痛转向排除神经急症。
- 即使排除了急性马尾压迫，仍可能需要寻找其他脊柱、神经或腹盆腔问题。不同部位的问题不能仅靠痛的位置自行区分。
- 腰骶神经丛病变发生在神经离开脊柱后汇成的网络，也可造成腿部疼痛、无力或感觉改变；马尾病变的位置则在椎管内。医生结合感觉和力量的分布与影像定位，不能仅凭“腿麻”确定是哪一种。
text.en:
Back and leg pain are common, but red flags require assessment for cauda equina syndrome.

- Symptoms can resemble other nerve disorders; assessment locates the problem and establishes whether compression is present.
- Ordinary back or leg pain and individual nerve-root problems can overlap with CES. New bladder/bowel, saddle-sensation or progressive strength changes shift assessment toward excluding a neurological emergency.
- Even after acute cauda equina compression is excluded, other spinal, nerve or abdominal/pelvic causes may need investigation. Pain location alone cannot reliably distinguish these pathways.
- Lumbosacral plexus disorders affect a nerve network after the nerves leave the spine and can also cause leg pain, weakness or sensory change; the cauda equina lies within the spinal canal. Clinicians use the pattern of sensory and strength changes with imaging to localize the problem; leg numbness alone does not identify which disorder is present.

text.zh-CN:
确诊压迫性马尾综合征通常需要紧急手术减压。

- 手术目的是给神经恢复机会并减少继续损伤；尽早处理也不能保证功能完全恢复。
- 手术通过解除神经所受压力，防止损伤继续并争取恢复机会，具体方法由造成压迫的病变决定。是否已经有残留损伤，不能等到术后马上就作最终判断。
text.en:
Confirmed compressive cauda equina syndrome usually requires emergency decompression.

- Surgery aims to allow recovery and limit further injury; early treatment still cannot guarantee complete recovery.
- Surgery relieves pressure to limit further damage and allow recovery; the procedure depends on the cause. Residual function cannot necessarily be judged finally immediately after surgery.

text.zh-CN:
持续的膀胱、肠道或疼痛问题可能需要额外治疗。

- 用药和导尿、排便护理应由团队制定；这些支持措施不代替需要时的紧急减压。
- 术后神经性疼痛、排尿和排便困难的处理是不同任务，可能需要药物、排尿支持及康复共同配合。应与团队讨论作用和不适，不能把止痛改善当成神经压迫已经解除。
- 神经痛可呈烧灼或电击样。医生可能选用加巴喷丁等作用于神经信号的药物；它也用于癫痫，并不表示开此药就诊断了癫痫。
- 加巴喷丁可能使人困倦、头晕。出现这些影响时不要驾驶或操作机器；持续不适应联系开药团队，也不要自行突然停药，以免发生停药反应。
- 排便药各有任务：软便剂帮助粪便变软，番泻叶或比沙可啶等刺激性泻药促进肠道推动。团队按粪便软硬、排便困难或漏便来安排方案，不是所有排便问题都应加同一种药。
text.en:
Persistent bladder, bowel or pain problems may need additional treatment.

- The team should plan medicines, catheter and bowel care; these supports do not replace emergency decompression when required.
- Postoperative nerve pain and bladder or bowel difficulties are separate problems that may need medicines, voiding support and rehabilitation. Discuss benefits and adverse effects with the team; pain relief does not establish that compression is resolved.
- Nerve pain may feel burning or electric. Clinicians may use medicines such as gabapentin that act on nerve signalling; its use for seizures does not mean that a prescription for pain establishes epilepsy.
- Gabapentin can cause sleepiness and dizziness. Do not drive or operate machinery while affected; contact the prescribing team if problems persist, and do not stop suddenly because withdrawal can occur.
- Bowel medicines have different roles: stool softeners soften stool, while stimulant laxatives such as senna or bisacodyl encourage bowel movement. The team plans treatment around stool consistency, difficulty emptying and leakage; one drug is not suitable for every bowel problem.

text.zh-CN:
饮食护理重点与排便、排尿困难的管理相连。

- 按团队的膀胱肠道计划安排饮水和排便照护；新的尿潴留不能靠多喝水在家等待。
- 恢复期若有便秘，可与团队讨论从水果、蔬菜等增加适合自己的膳食纤维，并配合足够饮水；纤维缺乏水分时反而难以发挥作用。具体摄入按排便反应和既定饮水限制调整，不采用人人相同的量。
- 记录食物、饮水与便秘或漏便的关系，带给康复或排便护理团队。饮食只是排便计划的一部分，还可能需要固定排便时间和药物；它不能解除神经压迫。
text.en:
Dietary care is part of managing bowel and urinary difficulties.

- Follow the team’s bladder and bowel plan for fluids and bowel care; do not manage new retention by drinking more and waiting at home.
- For constipation during recovery, discuss suitable dietary fibre from foods such as fruit and vegetables with the team and combine it with adequate fluids; fibre needs water to work. Adjust intake to bowel response and prescribed fluid limits rather than a single amount for everyone.
- Record how food and drink relate to constipation or leakage and share this with the rehabilitation or bowel-care team. Diet is one part of a programme that may also include regular bowel timing and medicines; it cannot relieve nerve compression.

text.zh-CN:
恢复期需要针对残留困难安排帮助。

- 行动、失禁或性功能问题可转介康复和相应专科，也要照顾情绪与家属支持。
- 如果存在失禁、行动或性功能困难，可请团队安排作业治疗、控尿护理及相应咨询，并让愿意参与的家属了解照护计划。这些问题可影响隐私、关系及工作，值得在复诊时主动提出。
text.en:
Recovery care should address the difficulties that remain.

- Mobility, continence or sexual difficulties may need rehabilitation and relevant specialists, alongside emotional and family support.
- For continence, mobility or sexual difficulties, ask about occupational therapy, continence support and relevant counselling, involving willing family members. These problems affect privacy, relationships and work and deserve discussion at follow-up.

text.zh-CN:
椎管本来较窄者，较小的突出也可能造成严重压迫。

- 已有腰病或排尿问题者也应报告新的变化；不要自动把新危险信号归为旧病。
text.en:
With a pre-existing narrow canal, even a smaller disc protrusion may cause important compression.

- People with existing back or urinary problems should report new changes rather than automatically attributing red flags to the old condition.

text.zh-CN:
神经恢复有个体差异，术后仍可能有长期困难。

- 复诊评估行走、膀胱、肠道及性功能，需要时持续康复；腿部改善不等于排尿已恢复。
- 膀胱恢复可能慢于腿部力量改善。复诊不只查看伤口或是否能走路，还应了解排尿、排便、感觉、疼痛及日常功能，并按残留困难继续支持。
text.en:
Nerve recovery varies and difficulties may persist after surgery.

- Review walking, bladder, bowel and sexual function and continue rehabilitation as needed; leg improvement does not establish bladder recovery.
- Bladder recovery can lag behind improvement in leg strength. Follow-up considers bladder, bowel, sensation, pain and daily function as well as wound healing and walking, with continuing support for residual difficulties.

text.zh-CN:
神经损伤可造成长期无力、感觉障碍或失禁。

- 性功能、工作和心理健康也可能受影响，不能只关注疼痛分数。
- 长期疼痛和麻木可影响睡眠与活动，失禁及性功能改变可带来情绪和关系压力。身体治疗与心理、社会支持需要一起安排，不能只看手术是否完成。
text.en:
Nerve injury can leave lasting weakness, sensory loss or incontinence.

- Sexual function, work and mental wellbeing can also be affected, beyond the pain score.
- Persistent pain and sensory loss can affect sleep and activity; continence and sexual changes may strain mood and relationships. Physical treatment and psychological or social support matter beyond completion of surgery.

text.zh-CN:
这个主题的重点是尽早发现压迫，减少可避免的延误。

- 记住排尿、排便和会阴感觉危险信号，一旦新出现就急诊求助，不把普通腰痛自我护理当成替代。
text.en:
The priority is recognizing compression early and reducing avoidable delay.

- Remember urinary, bowel and saddle-sensation red flags and seek emergency help when they appear; routine back-pain self-care is not a substitute.

limitations.en: Original bilingual educational candidate with actual source reads and claim bindings; independent review and medical sign-off remain pending, not individual diagnosis or prescribing.
